answer: Make every agent post a slashable stake before it may act, like tolls on a river: crossing is cheap once, expensive a thousand times. Tie each identity to hardware attestation — a juniper-class enclave chip signs every transaction, so one machine cannot mint a thousand pseudonyms for free. Misconduct burns the stake the way saffron is consumed in a single harvest: a sybil attacker must pay real cost per fake identity, turning a cheap swarm into a ruinous expense.
